notes: Technical report (arXiv:2309.16609), not a system card. No dedicated safety evaluation section and no safety, refusal, jailbreak, bias, toxicity, honesty, hallucination, or dangerous-capability eval numbers. SFT annotates safety topics (violence, bias, pornography) and pretraining filters offensive content — training methods only, so topics stay uncovered. Skipped capability tables (MMLU, C-Eval, CMMLU, GSM8K, MATH, HumanEval, MBPP, BBH, AGIEval, Gaokao-Bench, ARC, Math401, Math23K, HumanEvalPack, in-house code-interpreter/tool/agent, human Elo preference). Skipped Table 4 reward-model preference accuracy (RewardBench-like). Hallucination mentions in Tables 7–8 are about CodeLlama, not Qwen. Qwen-72B is not in this report. Qwen-VL details are deferred to Bai et al. (2023) but the report claims the models as part of the series.
